page_description_chirho: The Perffection business-platform direction, and the website you can begin with today: business intelligence, connected work and AI assistance, with availability stated plainly.

headline_lines_chirho: One useful step at a time.
hero_chirho.lead_chirho: The purpose is bigger than a website: software that helps you run your business, understand it and look after people. We are starting with a beautiful page. Here is what you can use by invitation now, and what we’re working toward.

inventory_chirho.note_chirho: Included means part of the website release, available by invitation. Planned means the wider business platform: not an available tool, a promised date or a purchase offer.

items_chirho.name_chirho: Your name and what you do
items_chirho.note_chirho: A clear headline and a few words about you, set beautifully.
Each with a short description, laid out so people find what they came for.

items_chirho.name_chirho: Tap to call, tap to email
items_chirho.note_chirho: Your number becomes a call button, and your email address opens a new message.
Opening hours, an address, or anything else people should know, right beside how to reach you.
Laid out for phones, tablets and computers without you lifting a finger.
Your name and your summary are what search engines read about you.

groups_chirho.intro_chirho: How you make it, and change it.

items_chirho.note_chirho: Your name, your headline, a few words, your services and how to reach you: one at a time, or all at once.

items_chirho.name_chirho: A preview before anyone sees it
items_chirho.note_chirho: See exactly what your visitors will see before it goes live.
One press and it is live at its own address on perffection.com.
Changed your mind? Put an earlier version back.
Download a copy of your page's words and details whenever you like.

groups_chirho.intro_chirho: The website details we look after.

items_chirho.note_chirho: Your page is served securely over HTTPS from the first day.
No plugins to install, nothing to renew, nothing to patch.
Published pages tell browsers to refuse scripts, reducing the code a visitor’s browser can run.
No analytics widgets, no advertising code, nothing watching the people who visit you.
No scripts to load, so your page opens quickly, even on a phone in a queue.
Your business name fills the top of the page, the footer and the browser tab from one answer.
The page API has been tested locally. Customer access needs an assistant key with enforced limits before we can offer it.

groups_chirho.intro_chirho: Where we’re headed, on Cairn’s foundation. These tools are not open to customers yet.

items_chirho.note_chirho: Bring your figures together, understand which work pays its way and ask questions that help you make considered decisions.
Keep enquiries, orders, notes and follow-ups connected, with access appropriate to the people doing the work.
Describe a useful tool or workflow for your business, review the result and choose what it may do. Platform AI and your own agent are both part of the direction.
Connect the information you already keep, rather than make a fresh copy for each job. Accounts, email and payments belong in the wider plan; no payment service is open here today.

items_chirho.name_chirho: Room for the communities you serve
items_chirho.note_chirho: A future white-label offering for people who want to serve their own customers and communities on this foundation.

fold_chirho.summary_chirho: For the person helping with your software
fold_chirho.intro_chirho: The plain-words lines above, as things a developer can check in a few minutes:
points_chirho: Pages are server-rendered HTML and CSS. Every response carries a Content-Security-Policy with script-src 'none', and no page contains a script element.
Every request a page makes goes to its own address: no fonts, pictures or scripts from anyone else.
An owner's page is a structured document, and the workspace downloads it as JSON.
Publishing is a signed, recorded release, and earlier published content can be put back. That does not undo an external disclosure or restore every earlier design.
The wider customer-records, business-intelligence and automation surfaces above are planned, not shipped APIs. They belong on Cairn’s reviewed execution path, not a separate product backend.

close_chirho.heading_chirho: A useful beginning, made with care.
close_chirho.body_chirho: The website is open by invitation. If you have one, sign in and begin with your name. The wider platform will grow from the same purpose: helping you do good work and look after the people who depend on it.
